prompt: Create a professional Hebrew Word document for an energy technology comparison report. It should have a main title in Hebrew, an introductory paragraph explaining the purpose, and a 3-column comparison table with Hebrew headers (טכנולוגיה, עלות ממוצעת, יעילות) and at least 3 data rows. Save as energy_report.docx and run the script.

assertions.description: A .docx file is saved to the output directory
Solution uses Python + zipfile approach (not npm docx library)
styles.xml defines a Normal style with w:styleId='Normal' and <w:bidi/>
document.xml contains <w:bidiVisual/> for correct RTL column order in table
document.xml contains Hebrew characters (Unicode range U+0590-U+05FF)
